name: Strike & correct: whole line struck
when: A claim people repeat that is wrong as a whole (a made-up budget, a fake date): the claim builds word by word, a bar strikes the whole line, and the correction lands under it. It sits on a soft, dark shot (see ground).
anchor: The bar crosses the claim (`strike`) once the voice has said it; the correction lands (`correct`) on the words that correct it.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.claim: the wrong claim, as people repeat it, 20 characters at most (one line)
vars.fix: the correction under it, 44 characters at most
vars.strike: seconds after the start: when the bar crosses the claim
vars.correct: seconds after the start: when the correction lands
vars.out: seconds after the start: when it starts to leave (the scene ends 0.23 s later)

changed: The lab clip ends on the held frame; the template leaves with a 7-frame fade at `out`.
